why_this_record: The launcher finished the search (ALL_DONE 2026-11-02T15:03:25Z) but its teardown gate refused: outcome.json records PRODUCTS_UNSECURED because the closeout pulled the Top-1's 1,192,135,096-byte model.safetensors to the dev box and the pull moved 5.7 MB in its 1,200 s limit. The pod was retained under the watchdog's verified ownership from 15:39:58Z. Nothing on the dev box reads those bytes: their one consumer is the train_a1 pod, which reads them on the network volume (training_plan.TOP1_ON_VOLUME). The Top-1 was therefore verified by sha256 on the volume and the pod torn down by hand; outcome.json is kept as the launcher wrote it.
